featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Anil Chakravarthy? The Bengaluru Boy Who Became a Chancellor's Gold Medalist, an MIT PhD, a Silicon Valley CEO — and Now Adobe's Next Leader
editorial.excerpt: Adobe's board has named Anil Chakravarthy as its next president and CEO, making him the second consecutive Indian-origin leader at the helm of the creative software giant. His journey from Basavanagudi to the C-suite is a story of quiet, methodical ambition.
editorial.image_caption: Anil Chakravarthy, who has been named Adobe's next CEO effective December 1, 2026, succeeding Shantanu Narayen.
editorial.nri_angle: Adobe's CEO succession from one Indian-origin leader to another underscores the growing dominance of Indian-educated executives in global tech leadership.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.excerpt: The entrepreneur and US citizen, who holds Global Entry clearance, described being pulled into a windowless room with other people of colour and questioned about his affiliations.

just_in.title: Google Commits Record $15 Billion to Finland AI Infrastructure in Largest European Bet
just_in.excerpt: The tech giant's biggest single European investment includes data centres, a 22-year nuclear power deal with Fortum, and grid upgrades — turning Finland into the 'Texas of Europe' for AI.
just_in.nri_angle: Google's massive Finland AI investment signals sustained demand for Indian tech talent and services across Europe's expanding data centre corridor.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Sensex Plunges 813 Points to Three-Month Low as Brent Crude Surges Past $100
just_in.excerpt: Indian benchmarks fell for a third consecutive session as escalating US-Iran hostilities pushed oil prices above $100 a barrel, triggering broad-based selling across sectors.
just_in.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. The Sensex plunged 813 points to a three-month low as Brent crude surged past $100 a barrel.
just_in.nri_angle: Elevated crude prices and a weakening rupee directly affect NRI remittance values and the purchasing power of Indian-origin investors holding domestic equities.

just_in.title: Abdullahs Stand for Full Vande Mataram as Congress Urges INDIA Bloc Allies to Follow Suit
just_in.excerpt: Omar and Farooq Abdullah stood through all six stanzas of the national song at a Srinagar film festival, exposing a rift within the opposition alliance over the Vande Mataram debate.

just_in.title: GalaxEye Secures US Patent for Dual-Sensor Satellite Imaging in Boost for India's Space Ambitions
just_in.excerpt: The IIT Madras-founded startup becomes the first Indian company to win a US patent for satellite imaging technology, covering its OptoSAR system that combines optical and radar sensors on a single platform.
just_in.image_caption: GalaxEye's Mission Drishti satellite during launch preparations on May 3, 2026. The 190-kilogram spacecraft is India's largest privately built Earth observation satellite and the world's first to combine optical and radar sensors on a single platform.
just_in.nri_angle: GalaxEye's US patent win underscores the growing role of IIT-trained founders in building globally competitive deep-tech companies from India, a trend that resonates with the diaspora's pride in Indian innovation.

just_in.title: NSE IPO Expected to Price at ₹1,700–1,785 Per Share in One of India's Biggest-Ever Listings
just_in.excerpt: The National Stock Exchange's long-awaited initial public offering could value the world's most active derivatives exchange at up to $46.4 billion, with listing expected the week of September 21.
just_in.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange of India in Mumbai. NSE is preparing for one of the country's biggest-ever initial public offerings, with shares expected to price between ₹1,700 and ₹1,785.

just_in.title: Xi and Modi Rebuild Ties as Two Asian Giants Seek Common Ground Before BRICS
just_in.excerpt: With Xi Jinping set to visit New Delhi for the BRICS summit this week, India and China are moving to repair a relationship damaged by border clashes and trade friction — driven by resumed flights, reopened trade crossings and a shared need to counter US tariff pressure.

just_in.nri_angle: The India-China diplomatic reset has direct implications for the Indian diaspora, as trade policies, investment flows and geopolitical alignment between the two Asian giants shape economic opportunities and strategic positioning for Indians worldwide.

news.image_caption: India has cleared defence acquisitions worth ₹1.1 lakh crore, with 98 percent sourced from domestic industry under the Make in India initiative.

news.image_caption: The United Kingdom has recognised India's carbon credit trading scheme, potentially easing the carbon tax burden on Indian exporters.
news.nri_angle: Indian-origin UK business owners importing carbon-intensive goods from India stand to benefit from lower CBAM compliance costs under the recognition.
